rows.note: real estate and movable assets of individuals (and their minor children) valued between TND 3 million and TND 5 million on 1 January, net of registered debts; main home, professional assets, cars up to 12 fiscal horsepower and bank deposits excluded. The law gives the rate by value band; whether a rate applies to the whole value or only to the band was not read (DGI note commune n° 13 of 2026 is in Arabic only and was not read). Return and payment by the end of June each year.

rows.section: Property acquisition, transfer and registration taxes
rows.note: price of transfers for consideration of the ownership, usufruct or bare ownership of real estate (registration duty). Progressive 1%, 2%, 3% and 5% rates by plot size apply to land bought to build individual homes (up to 120 m², 120-300 m², 300-600 m², above 600 m²).
rows.source_title: مجلة معاليم التسجيل والطابع الجبائي 2026 (Registration and Stamp Duties Code 2026)
rows.label: Registration duty on sales of real estate

rows.note: real estate and movable assets of individuals (and their minor children) valued between TND 3 million and TND 5 million on 1 January, net of registered debts; main home, professional assets, cars up to 12 fiscal horsepower and bank deposits excluded. The law gives the rate by value band; whether a rate applies to the whole value or only to the band was not read (DGI note commune n° 13 of 2026 is in Arabic only and was not read). Return and payment by the end of June each year.

rows.label: Tourist stay tax (taxe de séjour)
rows.value: Due by each resident over 12; the tax paid per resident is capped at the amount for 10 consecutive nights: TND 1 (Tunisians and Maghreb nationals) or TND 4 (foreigners) in 2-star hotels and other tourist accommodation; TND 2 or 8 in 3-star hotels; TND 3 or 12 in 4- and 5-star hotels

rows.value: Flat-rate regime for individual businesses with industrial and commercial profits from a single establishment and turnover of up to TND 100,000 (not importers, wholesalers or VAT-registered, among other conditions), for 6 years renewable: TND 400 a year up to TND 10,000 of turnover in communal zones (half elsewhere), 3% of turnover between TND 10,000 and 100,000
